method: Each pre-existing PNG was opened with view_image at original resolution; no application was opened, rendered, built or modified for this review.
fixture: One retained ProjectWorkspaceView host; fictional captures and local blue/gold PNG; 960 by 820 logical points at 2x backing scale; isolated archive/defaults, offscreen non-key window and private pasteboards.

suites.name: ProjectWorkspaceViewTests
suites.reportedSummary: PASS: 918 project workspace UI checks; 1,000 synthetic text captures plus image and editable project note; retained-host live zoom, observable edits and replacement identities; native mixed-selection drag payloads on a private pasteboard; no personal archive, network, general clipboard or external opening. At most 27 simultaneously materialized native rows.

suites.name: ProjectWorkspaceCardTests
suites.reportedSummary: PASS: 782 project card checks; Task/Note/Capture semantics, real live task updates, light/dark/grid/320-point compact fixtures, original previews and independent selection; no personal archive, clipboard, network, or external opening.

suites.name: NativeContentDragTests
suites.reportedSummary: PASS: 38 native content drag checks; clicks, mixed native items, copy-only external transfers and source preservation.

findings: The Project notes card visibly contains “Fictional initial live project note” in full.
The image card shows the blue/gold fictional source, a deliberate two-line title ellipsis, project, role and immutable receipt.
The ordinary task remains unchecked with a readable original-text excerpt, and all four cards and their receipts fit the viewport.
The same Project notes card now visibly contains “Fictional live note edited after the retained browser zoom”, wrapping onto two readable lines; the initial text is absent.
The restored task shows its current title with the intentional two-line limit, strikethrough, checked completion control, green edge and “Task · Done” status.
The saved image and previous-day capture remain visible; no card controls overlap the edited note text.
Typography and the actual blue/gold media preview are visibly smaller than in the 200% image; the complete source remains fitted within the rounded preview.
Titles, project labels, excerpts, roles and date/clock receipts remain readable and separated.
Selection and completion controls remain distinct from titles and More controls; all four cards fit without clipped receipts.
The actual media preview and typography grow relative to the 75% image while the project toolbar, footer and selection/completion artwork retain their own sizes.
Long card titles use the intended two-line ellipsis and supporting excerpts wrap naturally without covering controls.
The note, task and capture keep distinct visible roles and receipts; all four cards fit the viewport with no observed overlap or clipped card content.

pairedFindings: The initial and edited note images prove visible old-to-new scratchpad content on the retained host, separately from accessibility values.
The 75% and 200% images show live typography/media scaling and readable complete card content; deliberate title truncation is preserved.

The new integration assertions additionally verify native 32-point targets, the same table and gesture-locked rows, replacement capture actions, focus/selection, filters/dates and latest native drag payloads.
limitations: Static offscreen screenshots do not establish animation quality, input latency, GPU frame pacing, every display configuration, dark mode, contrast compliance or App Store approval.
The strict unsampled zoom performance gate remains unresolved; this visual pass does not override the 50 ms input and 33 ms timer thresholds.
Pre-existing native table reentrancy/truncation warnings remain separately documented in layout-candidate-4/profile/analysis.md.
